events_agenda_idx.name: events_agenda_idx
events_agenda_idx.where: "events"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND NOT "events"."long_running" AND "events"."kind" <> 'step' AND "events"."deleted_at" IS NULL

events_tracked_idx.name: events_tracked_idx
events_tracked_idx.where: "events"."status" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."kind" <> 'step' AND "events"."deleted_at" IS NULL

events_status_matches_actor.name: events_status_matches_actor
events_status_matches_actor.value: ("events"."actor" = 'human' AND ("events"."status" IS NULL OR "events"."status" IN ('todo', 'toDefine', 'doing', 'inHold', 'done', 'cancel', 'missed'))) OR ("events"."actor" = 'agent' AND "events"."status" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."status" IN ('queued', 'running', 'waiting', 'done', 'failed', 'cancel'))

events_long_running_shape.name: events_long_running_shape
events_long_running_shape.value: NOT "events"."long_running" OR ("events"."actor" = 'human' AND "events"."status" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."status" <> 'missed' AND "events"."recurrence_id" IS NULL)

events_long_running_notify.name: events_long_running_notify
events_long_running_notify.value: NOT "events"."long_running" OR "events"."estimated_finish_at" IS NOT NULL OR cardinality("events"."notify_offsets_minutes") = 0

events_block_span.name: events_block_span
events_block_span.value: "events"."long_running" OR "events"."started_at" IS NULL OR "events"."estimated_finish_at" IS NULL OR ("events"."estimated_finish_at" >= "events"."started_at" AND "events"."estimated_finish_at" - "events"."started_at" <= interval '31 days')

events_occurrence_requires_day.name: events_occurrence_requires_day
events_occurrence_requires_day.value: "events"."recurrence_id" IS NULL OR "events"."occurrence_on" IS NOT NULL
